title: Adic-lisse modules over a completed coefficient sheaf
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme, $A$ a commutative Noetherian ring and $I\subset A$ an ideal. Work on the small pro-etale site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For an $A$-module $N$, write $\underline{N/I^nN}$ for the sheafification of the constant presheaf of $A/I^n$-modules [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Put
$$\widehat A_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}\underline{A/I^n},\qquad \widehat{\underline N}_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}\underline{N/I^nN}.$$
The transition maps are induced by the quotient maps. On an object of the site the inverse limit is the set of compatible families of sections; addition and the $\widehat A_X$-action are componentwise. Modules and their morphisms are sheaves of modules as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

An $A$-module $N$ is $I$-adically complete if the map $N\to\varprojlim_n N/I^nN$, sending an element to all its residue classes, is an isomorphism. A module is of finite type if it is generated by a finite list of elements (when A/I is finite, as in the coefficient datum of the parent item, this is equivalent to the finite underlying set condition in Stacks Tag 09BT(3)). A sheaf $F$ of $\widehat A_X$-modules is *adic lisse of finite type* if there is a pro-etale covering $\{V_j\to X\}_j$ and, for every $j$, an $I$-adically complete $A$-module $N_j$ with $N_j/IN_j$ of finite type over $A/I$, together with a $\widehat A_X|_{V_j}$-linear isomorphism
$$F|_{V_j}\simeq\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(\underline{N_j/I^nN_j})|_{V_j}.$$
Here restrictions are to the localized site, and the coefficient sheaf on it is the restriction of $\widehat A_X$. No freeness or finiteness of the underlying set of $N_j$ is required.

The same relative notion is used after inverse image along a morphism $u:Y\to X$: for a sheaf of $u^{-1}\widehat A_X$-modules on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, the local model on a covering member $V\to Y$ is $\varprojlim_n (u^{-1}\underline{N/I^nN})|_V$. Its coefficient action is through the natural map $(u^{-1}\widehat A_X)|_V\to\varprojlim_n (u^{-1}\underline{A/I^n})|_V$ induced by the limit projections [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. This definition does not identify inverse image of an infinite limit with the limit of the inverse images.
